purpose: §5.3 negative-control LoRA — does arithmetic-domain training close the FVQ/CVQ gap?
data_source: openai/gsm8k main train split (7,473 examples → 6,726 train + 747 val)
data_format: full GSM8K (no single-token filter): question → CoT reasoning + #### numeric answer
deviation_from_PLAN_MD: PLAN.md Decision 7 specifies single-token numeric answers; we used full GSM8K including chain-of-thought reasoning to give a stronger control (even arithmetic reasoning training does not close the gap).
stop_reason: Stopped at step 100 after first eval. Loss plateaued at 0.29 (train) / 0.31 (val); model demonstrably learned GSM8K (69.6% test accuracy vs 16% baseline). Further training not needed for the control conclusion.

fvq_cvq_held_out_eval.compared_to_main_lora: main task-specific LoRA fixes 28/28 cells (RI~100%, PI~95-100%); this arith control fixes 0/5
